name: Rare Michigan | Jesus OG
description: Jesus OG: All hail the king! This fiery Sativa has a long held lineage as the reigning sativa champion. There are endless details to look at within these nugs. Striking pistils and fields of keefy trichomes, you will be stuck staring at these beautiful buds before throwing them in the grinder. Containing and dominated by the unique “Terpinolene” and followed by hops and cinnamon. Touch the skies and enjoy the amazing mind high from Jesus OG.
